meaning.zh:
“改变表现或者被解雇” 或 “要么改进，要么走人”。

这个短语源自海军术语，原指水手必须提高表现否则会被赶下船。这一表达现在通常用于工作环境中，意指一个人需要改进表现，不然就可能面临解雇或者离开岗位。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from naval terminology, where sailors were expected to improve their behavior or face being sent off the ship. In modern settings, it is commonly used in workplaces to imply that someone needs to improve their performance or risk being fired or removed from their position.

lines.en: The manager told the underperforming employee to *shape up or ship out*.
lines.zh: 经理告诉表现不佳的员工要么改进，要么走人。

lines.en: If you don't start meeting deadlines, you'll have to *shape up or ship out*.
lines.zh: 如果你不能按时完成任务，你要么改进要么就得走人。

lines.en: *Shape up or ship out* is the new policy for all employees this year.
lines.zh: 今年所有员工都要遵循 “要么改进，要么走人” 的新政策。
